user_query: My company is organizing a charity event and we need some promotional materials. Can you suggest some creative ideas for flyers, posters, and banners? Additionally, recommend a reliable printing service.

TaskList.description: Research and brainstorm creative ideas for flyers, posters, and banners for the charity event.
Compile the creative ideas into a document or presentation format for review.
Research reliable printing services that can produce the promotional materials designed.
Compare the recommended printing services based on price, quality, and turnaround time.
